}}{{TournamentPageStart|twitchid=lck|toclimit=2|text=The '''LCK 2020 Summer Season''' is the second split of the 2020 Season of '''League Champions Korea'''. Ten teams compete in the Summer double round-robin group stage. The top five teams qualify for the 2020 Summer Playoffs.}}

== Overview ==
=== Format ===
* Double Round Robin
* Matches are best of three
* Top 5 teams qualify for [[LCK/2020 Season/Summer Playoffs|Playoffs]]
:* Regular Season winner receives a bye to the finals
:* Second and third place teams receive byes to Round 3 and Round 2 respectively
* {{TiebreakerRules|
:* If two teams have the same record, ties will be broken by:
::* Game record (teams get +1 point for a won game, -1 point for a lost game, the team with more points wins the tie)
::* If points are tied, ties are broken by head to head <!--(game) must actually be series-->record
::* If still tied, teams will play a tiebreaker match.}}
